_note: Run from an interactive terminal session; for the cross-machine evals it must be connected to Remote Control. Background sessions consume usage like interactive ones.

evals.prompt: give me the state of all my sessions: which ones are blocked and on what, which ones are done and what they produced
evals.expected_output: orchestrator.py sync then report (no SendMessage): sessions bucketed NEEDS INPUT with the `needs` text, WORKING, FINISHED with output.result, remote/offline apart; blocked ones surfaced first with how to unblock (claude agents peek/attach); no order sent.

evals.prompt: run the test suite of ~/src/app and the lint of ~/src/infra in parallel, in the background, and tell me when both are done with the real results
evals.expected_output: Two `claude --bg` dispatches with self-contained prompts and --name, sync + assign one tag each, wait on notifications (no tight loop), read jobs/<id>/state.json / claude logs / get_run_log, resolve each with the harness's done|failed as ground truth, one aggregated report quoting actual outputs.

evals.prompt: ask my workspace session (already running) to run the polaris gate and my pi-lab session on the Pi to check disk space; one of them may be offline
evals.expected_output: ListAgents, one assign + SendMessage envelope per target with distinct tags, notify_when_idle only for the same-machine one, callback requested from the remote one, offline target reported without resending, get_run_log read with session_01… ids, both resolved, report with names and ids.
